subject: SolarForge trial ops manifest & prompt-eval roadmap
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Tom Evans <tom.evans@solarforge.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@solarforge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: SolarForge trial ops manifest & prompt-eval roadmap

Hi Tom / Elena —

Thanks again for the time earlier today. Quick recap and proposed ops manifest so we can lock the 4-week trial scope and next steps. If any of this looks off, call it out and we’ll adjust before Friday.

High-level customer pain & goals (as we heard it):
- Reconciliation engine misclassifies invoice types ~12% of the time; manual review is a bottleneck.
- Model latency on current infra spikes during day which breaks downstream processing windows.
- Strict cost target for inference: <$0.006 per processed invoice on a 90th percentile basis.

Proposed 4-week trial scope (operational + eval):
1) Data slice: 25k anonymized historical invoice events (sample rows - see attachment data-access-template.csv).
2) Modeling: compare three serving variants: redwood-3b-q4_0, redwood-8b-fp16, and a community-derived 7B-int8 baseline.
3) Metrics & success criteria:
   - Latency p50 < 200ms, p95 < 450ms (end-to-end token generation).
   - Throughput target: sustain 100 req/min with autoscaling policy demonstration.
   - Accuracy / precision@1 > 85% on invoice-type classification set (primary success metric).
   - Hallucination / free-text error rate < 2% on verification prompts.
   - Cost target: average token cost <= $0.006 per invoice processed.
4) Prompt set & evals: we’ll run your current prompt bank (we discussed 18 canonical prompts) + adversarial set of 50 edge cases. Redwood will provide an eval harness and sample grading rubric.
5) Owners & contact points:
   - Redwood AM: Lukas Meyer (me) — overall project owner, escalation.
   - Redwood SE: Marissa Cole — model tuning, prompt engineering, eval runs.
   - Redwood Data Ops: Priyom Das — data ingestion, S3 access, and transformation checks.
   - SolarForge PM: Tom Evans — primary decision maker for scope.
   - SolarForge Data Eng: Elena Ruiz — will provision access and validate sample exports.

Access / setup checklist (what we need from SolarForge):
- A sample S3 bucket or export (25k rows anonymized). Template attached.
- A service account for read-only data access + any IP allowlist info for VPC peering.
- Point of contact for procurement/legal (if you’d like, loop in legal@solarforge.com for the MSA).

Attachments: solarforge-pilot-charter.pdf (pilot charter), data-access-template.csv (sample schema).

Immediate next steps (proposed timeline):
- Wed 2026-08-04: SolarForge shares sample dataset + IAM details.
- Thu 2026-08-05: Redwood SE performs initial data validation and posts any schema gaps.
- Mon 2026-08-09: Kickoff (runbook review + baseline eval on 1k rows).
- Mon 2026-08-09 to Mon 2026-09-06: Trial execution + weekly checkpoints (Wednesdays).

Can we lock Wed 8/4 for the data handoff? If procurement needs a draft SOW / MSA now, we can push a redline for review — I’ll include a DocuSign link in my follow-up.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,

Lukas Meyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lukas.meyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

--

Thanks Lukas — this is very helpful and captures the discussion. A few quick items from our side: 

1) Can you confirm the billing model for the trial? We want to understand expected spend if we run 100k invoices through the test harness (ballpark).
2) SOC 2 reports / security evidence: our procurement will need SOC 2 Type II and network architecture diagram for any VPC peering.
3) Legal wants to review an MSA before the trial starts — I’ll loop legal@solarforge.com on the thread.

We can do the dataset handoff on Wed 8/4 as proposed. I’ll get Elena to prepare the export and the S3 location.

Also — one small ask: can Redwood run a short smoke test on a 500-row subset to show the baseline latency numbers before the kickoff? That helps our architecture team.

Thanks,
Tom
Product Manager | SolarForge Energy
tom.evans@solarforge.com | (617) 555-2290

Tom — appreciate the quick read. Short answers: 

- Billing for trial: Redwood can run the smoke & evaluation at no charge. If you elect to run the full 100k evaluation we’ll provide an estimated cost sheet; ballpark inference cost for redwood-8b-fp16 at scale is ~$0.0045 per invoice (depends on tokenization) — we’ll provide a precise estimate after the 500-row smoke test.
- Security evidence: attaching a short SOC2 bridge doc and our network diagram; Marissa I’ve copied you to coordinate any additional artifacts procurement asks for.
- Smoke test: yes — we’ll run a 500-row smoke test on Monday 8/9 and post latency/throughput numbers same day.

Operational clarifications / additions:
- Canary & fallback: we recommend starting the trial with redwood-3b-q4_0 as the low-cost control, run redwood-8b-fp16 as the quality arm, and enable an automatic fallback to the 3B variant for cost spikes. We’ll demonstrate the routing policy in the first weekly checkpoint.
- Eval rubric: Marissa will upload the grading script (precision/recall, hallucination flags, and a short human review UI) to the Drive link below before the kickoff.

DocuSign: https://redwood.docusign.com/sf-msa-2026 (we’ll push an MSA with trial language; legal can redline).
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567
Drive (eval artifacts): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cC

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (workplan with weekly checkpoints).

If that all sounds good I’ll schedule the Mon 8/9 kickoff (30–45m runbook + eval demo).

Best,
Lukas

2) Prompt tuning & eval harness (Marissa) — prep grading script, upload prompts and adversarial set to Drive by Fri 8/6. Deliverable: eval_harness_v1.zip + prompt_matrix.csv.
3) Smoke test (Lukas + Marissa) — run 500-row baseline on Mon 8/9, capture latency p50/p95 and token counts; share result deck same day.

Marking owners on HubSpot and adding the mutual action plan into the deal record after the kickoff.
